cards.card_text: Then Paul asks: did he make that plan carelessly, or by human standards, saying “Yes, yes” and also “No, no”? That's somebody arguing with the snooze button: YES I'm up, NO I'm not, YES I'm up, no I'm NOT.
cards.verse_text: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” and also “No, no”?
